# Health Plus International

> Health Plus International is a healthcare workforce development business in Helensburgh, NSW. HPI recruits, employs and places healthcare workers in Sydney and regional NSW. HPI does not train workers.

## Roles

Registered Nurses; Assistants in Nursing; aged care workers; support workers (community and in-home support, not NDIS); allied health professionals.

## How we work

HPI employs the workers. The facility chooses who it accepts and directs day-to-day work and clinical supervision. Regional work is planned for each engagement. Listing a region does not mean a vacancy is open.
